<thought>All measured resistances are consistent with a single series chain from node A (0 Ω) to node B (140 Ω). Ordering the intermediate nodes by their measured distance from A gives the resistor values:
A‑N_a1 5 Ω, N_a1‑N_a2 10 Ω, N_a2‑N_a3 15 Ω, N_a3‑X1 20 Ω, X1‑N_b1 10 Ω, N_b1‑N_b2 15 Ω, N_b2‑X2 20 Ω, X2‑N_c1 10 Ω, N_c1‑N_c2 15 Ω, N_c2‑B 20 Ω. This series topology reproduces every listed node‑to‑node resistance (each is the absolute difference of the node potentials). The required JSON describing the circuit is therefore:</thought>
<final_answer>{
  "resistors": {
    "R1": 5.0,
    "R2": 10.0,
    "R3": 15.0,
    "R4": 20.0,
    "R5": 10.0,
    "R6": 15.0,
    "R7": 20.0,
    "R8": 10.0,
    "R9": 15.0,
    "R10": 20.0
  },
  "connections": [
    ["A", "N_a1", "R1"],
    ["N_a1", "N_a2", "R2"],
    ["N_a2", "N_a3", "R3"],
    ["N_a3", "X1", "R4"],
    ["X1", "N_b1", "R5"],
    ["N_b1", "N_b2", "R6"],
    ["N_b2", "X2", "R7"],
    ["X2", "N_c1", "R8"],
    ["N_c1", "N_c2", "R9"],
    ["N_c2", "B", "R10"]
  ]
}</final_answer>
